cast.comment: Where to click to throw the rod. Usually the center of the screen. Values are 0..1 fractions of the screen.

shake.comment: Region (0..1 fractions) scanned for the white 'Shake!' prompt/button. The macro clicks the brightest matching blob it finds.

reel.comment: Reeling minigame. 'region' is the whole bar. We track the moving target zone (fish) and the player control marker, then hold/release left-click to keep them aligned.

progress.comment: Optional: a region that turns bright/green as the catch completes. When it is 'full' we stop reeling.

catch.comment: After a fish is landed, screenshot this region (the caught-fish popup) and let the Hugging Face 'brain' decide if it is a good catch. If good, press favorite_key to keep it.

huggingface.comment: Cloud AI brain (no local GPU needed). Get a free token at https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens and paste it below, OR set the HF_API_TOKEN environment variable. Leave enabled=false to skip and just keep every catch.
candidate_labels: a rare or legendary shiny fish
junk trash or an old boot
good_labels: a rare or legendary shiny fish
